name: Spinning Top (Print in Place)
description: A spinning top that comes off the plate ready to spin, with no assembly and no supports. One piece: a solid top printed face down, so its two-colour spiral, ray, ring or dot pattern is bed-smooth, with a grip stem standing in a well in the face. With launcher: the top's stem is a gear, printed in place inside a launcher housing with a pull rack threaded through it. Gyro ring: the one-piece top with a free ring printed in place around its rim. Up to ten colour parameters: body, two pattern colours, name, rim, stem, tip, ring, launcher and rack.
source: inspired by Printables "Pull Start Spinning Top Launcher" (Medweator, 497 downloads, a rack-and-gear launcher printed as separate parts), "Spinning top Print in place" (MdeMAKER, 158) and "Spinning Top (Print-in-Place)" (kida, 135), with the captive ring of print-in-place gyro fidgets such as "Gyro Fidget Spinner" (Maker Lessons, 7,727)
